title: 277. Scramble String

examples.explanation: Split into gr/eat, swap the first half to rg, then rejoin as rgeat.
No sequence of recursive swaps turns abcde into caebd.

hints: Try every split point with both the straight and swapped matchings, memoizing (i, j, length) results.
Prune with character counts: mismatched frequency means the pair cannot be scrambles.
Equal substrings are an immediate true without further splitting.
